superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Observer and Connector are arguing over stale ceilings: between 07:00 and 08:00, the highest PM10 moved from 9 to 16 µg/m³ [F5], the highest PM2.5 moved from 8 to 16 µg/m³ [F9], and the highest NO2 moved from 21 to 22 µg/m³ [F7]. Banovo brdo now holds the 16 µg/m³ ceiling for both PM10 and PM2.5 while Vračar Dom zdravlja holds the 6 µg/m³ floor for both [F4][F8], and Borča holds the 22 µg/m³ NO2 ceiling against 5 µg/m³ at Pančevo Sodara [F6]. Still, with 0 days of baseline against the required 30 days and 20 values per hour [F49], none of these shifts tell us whether the morning is unusual, and the 8913 values from 46 Sensor.Community instruments [F10] remain uncompared against SEPA's 31 instruments [F2].
